title: TRĀYA 2.0 Canonical Landslide & Slope-Failure Record (v1)
description: Formal schema strictly partitioning slope-failure records into five canonical feature types and enforcing null-not-0 semantics for unknown dates and casualty/impact counts (reserving 0 strictly for verified zero-casualty official records).

id.description: Globally unique stable record identifier prefixed by provider (e.g., bipad_96552, coolr_12345, osm_n1812714613).

feature_type.description: Strict 5-class partition separating dated events, undated geomorphic scars, static susceptibility zones, unverified community/field observations, and earthquake-triggered slope failures.

provider_id.description: Canonical machine identifier for the upstream data provider.

source.description: Human-readable attribution string for the upstream source.

data_class.description: Epistemic class distinguishing statutory official observations, curated catalogs, undated mapped inventories, community reports, and static assessments.

title.description: Concise English or primary title of the event or mapped feature.

title_ne.description: Optional Nepali (Devanagari) title when provided by upstream source (e.g., BIPAD titleNe); null if unavailable.

event_date_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC event date/timestamp for dated events; MUST be null when unknown or for undated scars.

date_precision.description: Temporal precision of event_date_utc; MUST be 'unknown' whenever event_date_utc is null.

lon.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees (Nepal region bounds).

lat.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees (Nepal region bounds).

district.description: Canonical Nepal district name (77-district OSM admin_level=6 lookup); null if outside boundary.

province.description: Canonical Nepal province name (7 provinces); null if outside boundary.

trigger.description: Physical trigger or classification (e.g., rainfall, earthquake, mapped scar, unknown).

fatalities.description: Confirmed fatalities. Unknown values MUST be null; 0 is strictly reserved for verified zero-casualty official records (verified=true).

injuries.description: Confirmed injuries. Unknown values MUST be null; 0 is strictly reserved for verified zero-casualty official records (verified=true).

households_affected.description: Confirmed affected households/families. Unknown values MUST be null; 0 is strictly reserved for verified official records (verified=true).

verified.description: True strictly for officially verified statutory/agency records (e.g., BIPAD NDRRMA verified=true).

evidence_url.description: Nullable HTTPS URL pointing to the upstream evidence record.

license_ref.description: Upstream data license or terms reference.

date.description: Backward-compatible YYYY-MM-DD alias of event_date_utc for legacy UI consumers.

url.description: Backward-compatible string URL alias of evidence_url (empty string when null) for legacy UI consumers.

admin.description: Backward-compatible administrative division string for legacy UI consumers.

category.description: Backward-compatible landslide category string (e.g., landslide, debris_flow, rockfall, cliff).

size.description: Optional qualitative event size descriptor when reported upstream.
